Sifat cahaya dan organ mata: Properties of light and the eye
Cahaya merambat lurus, menembus benda be: Light travels in straight lines, passes through clear objects, and can be reflected, refracted, and dispersed (rainbow).
Transparan (bening, semua cahaya lewat),: Transparent (clear, all light passes through), translucent (some light passes through), and opaque (no light passes through).
Cermin datar membentuk bayangan sama bes: A plane mirror forms an image of the same size. A convex mirror makes things smaller (rear-view mirror). A concave mirror makes things bigger (torch, dentist's mirror).
Kornea melindungi dan meneruskan cahaya,: The cornea protects and passes light through, the iris controls the pupil, the pupil controls how much light enters, the lens focuses, the retina captures the image, and the optic nerve sends it to the brain.
Rabun jauh (miopi) ditolong lensa cekung: Short-sightedness (myopia) is helped by a concave lens, long-sightedness (hypermetropia) by a convex lens, cataracts happen when the lens becomes cloudy, and night blindness comes from a lack of vitamin A.
Membaca dengan cahaya cukup pada jarak s: Read with enough light at a distance of about 30 cm, don't stare at screens for too long, eat foods with vitamin A, and don't rub your eyes with dirty hands.
Bagian Mata dan Fungsinya: Parts of the Eye and Their Functions
Lapisan bening di depan yang melindungi: The clear layer at the front that protects the eye and passes light through.
Selaput pelangi yang memberi warna mata: The coloured membrane that gives the eye its colour and controls the size of the pupil.
Lubang di tengah iris yang mengatur bany: The hole in the middle of the iris that controls how much light enters.
Bersifat cembung dan memfokuskan cahaya: It is convex and focuses light onto the retina.
Selaput jala, tempat jatuhnya bayangan b: The inner layer where the image of an object falls.
Sends messages from the retina to the brain.
Jalur cahaya: kornea → pupil → lensa → r: Path of light: cornea → pupil → lens → retina → optic nerve → brain.
Sifat bunyi dan organ telinga: Properties of sound and the ear
Bunyi berasal dari benda yang bergetar d: Sound comes from vibrating objects and needs a medium to travel. Sound cannot travel through a vacuum.
Paling cepat di zat padat, lalu zat cair: Fastest in solids, then liquids, and slowest in gases (air).
Gema adalah bunyi pantul yang terdengar: An echo is a reflected sound heard after the original sound (valleys, cliffs). A reverberation is heard mixed with the original sound (closed rooms).
Frequency determines whether a sound is high or low. Amplitude determines whether a sound is loud or soft. Infrasonic < 20 Hz, audiosonic 20–20,000 Hz, ultrasonic > 20,000 Hz.
Telinga luar: daun telinga dan saluran t: Outer ear: the ear flap and ear canal. Middle ear: the eardrum and three ear bones (hammer, anvil, stirrup). Inner ear: the cochlea and the auditory nerve.
Bersihkan bagian luar dengan lembut, jan: Clean the outer ear gently, don't poke inside with hard objects, don't play headphones too loudly, and avoid noisy places.
Bagian Telinga dan Fungsinya: Parts of the Ear and Their Functions
Selaput tipis yang bergetar saat bunyi t: A thin membrane that vibrates when sound arrives.
Martil, landasan, dan sanggurdi menguatk: The hammer, anvil, and stirrup strengthen and pass on the vibrations.
Rumah siput yang mengubah getaran menjad: The snail-shaped part that turns vibrations into nerve signals.
Sends sound signals to the brain.
Bunyi butuh medium; tidak dapat merambat: Sound needs a medium; it cannot travel through a vacuum.
Ekosistem adalah hubungan timbal balik a: An ecosystem is the two-way relationship between living things, other living things, and their environment.
Makhluk hidup: produsen (tumbuhan hijau: Living things: producers (green plants that photosynthesise), consumers (animals and humans), and decomposers (fungi and bacteria).
Benda tak hidup: air, udara, tanah, caha: Non-living things: water, air, soil, sunlight, temperature, humidity, rocks, and wind.
Herbivora pemakan tumbuhan, karnivora pe: Herbivores eat plants, carnivores eat meat, omnivores eat both, and insectivores eat insects.
Ekosistem darat (hutan, padang rumput, g: Land ecosystems (forests, grasslands, deserts), water ecosystems (rivers, lakes, seas, swamps), and man-made ecosystems (rice fields, gardens, fish ponds, aquariums).
Tumbuhan hijau yang membuat makanan send: Green plants that make their own food through photosynthesis.
Hewan dan manusia yang tidak dapat membu: Animals and humans that cannot make their own food.
Jamur dan bakteri yang menguraikan sisa: Fungi and bacteria that break down the remains of living things into nutrients.
Air, udara, tanah, cahaya matahari, suhu: Water, air, soil, sunlight, temperature, and other non-living things.
Ingat: biotik = makhluk hidup, abiotik =: Remember: biotic = living things, abiotic = non-living things.
Perpindahan energi dari satu makhluk hid: The transfer of energy from one living thing to another through a sequence of eating and being eaten.
Sumber energi utama adalah matahari. Tan: The main source of energy is the sun. The arrow (→) means "is eaten by" and shows the direction energy moves.
Rantai selalu dimulai dari produsen, lal: A chain always starts with a producer, then level I consumers (herbivores), level II, level III, and ends with decomposers. Example: rice → mouse → snake → eagle.
Gabungan beberapa rantai makanan yang sa: A combination of several connected food chains. One creature can eat or be eaten by more than one kind.
Semakin tinggi tingkat konsumen, jumlah: The higher the consumer level, the fewer the individuals and the less energy there is. If one link in the chain disappears, the balance is disturbed.
Produsen — membuat makanan sendiri lewat: Producer — makes its own food through photosynthesis.
Konsumen tingkat I (herbivora) — memakan: Level I consumer (herbivore) — eats the producer.
Konsumen tingkat II (karnivora) — memaka: Level II consumer (carnivore) — eats the mouse.
Level III consumer — the top predator.
Pengurai — menguraikan sisa makhluk hidu: Decomposer — breaks down the remains of living things into nutrients.
Rantai makanan selalu mulai dari produse: A food chain always starts with a producer; the most energy is in the producer.
Hubungan antar makhluk hidup dalam ekosi: Relationships between living things in an ecosystem
Hubungan erat antara dua makhluk hidup y: A close relationship between two living things of different species. There are three kinds: mutualism, commensalism, and parasitism.
Kedua pihak saling untung. Contoh: lebah: Both sides benefit. Examples: bees and flowers, clownfish and sea anemones, Rhizobium bacteria in the roots of legumes.
Satu pihak untung, pihak lain tidak untu: One side benefits, the other neither benefits nor is harmed. Examples: orchids attached to trees, remora fish on sharks.
Satu pihak untung (parasit), pihak lain: One side benefits (the parasite), the other is harmed (the host). Examples: mistletoe on trees, tapeworms in the human gut, lice on the head.
Predasi adalah hubungan pemangsa dan man: Predation is the relationship between a predator and its prey (lions and zebras). Competition is the struggle for limited resources (corn and weeds).
Bentuk Hubungan Antar Makhluk Hidup: Types of Relationships Between Living Things
Keduanya untung, misalnya lebah dan bung: Both benefit, for example bees and flowers.
Satu untung, satu netral, misalnya anggr: One benefits, one is unaffected, for example orchids on trees.
Satu untung, satu rugi, misalnya benalu: One benefits, one is harmed, for example mistletoe on trees.
Pemangsa memakan mangsa, misalnya singa: A predator eats its prey, for example lions and zebras.
Persaingan sumber daya, misalnya jagung: Competing for resources, for example corn and weeds.
Untung-untung mutualisme, untung-netral: Benefit-benefit is mutualism, benefit-neutral is commensalism, benefit-harm is parasitism.
Penebangan dan pembakaran hutan liar, pe: Illegal logging and forest burning, hunting rare animals, pollution of water/soil/air, too many pesticides, and changing land use.
Banjir, tanah longsor, kekeringan, kepun: Floods, landslides, droughts, extinction of animals and plants, and global warming.
Reboisasi (penghijauan), tebang pilih, m: Reforestation (regreening), selective logging, throwing rubbish in its proper place, and applying the 3Rs: reduce, reuse, recycle.
Cagar alam, suaka margasatwa, dan taman: Nature reserves, wildlife sanctuaries, and national parks are created to protect plants and animals from extinction.
Harimau Sumatra, orangutan, badak Jawa,: The Sumatran tiger, orangutan, Javan rhino, Komodo dragon, and Bali myna need to be protected from illegal hunting.
Reduce (mengurangi), reuse (memakai ulan: Reduce (use less), reuse (use again), recycle (make into something new).
Cagar alam, suaka margasatwa, dan taman: Nature reserves, wildlife sanctuaries, and national parks.
Menebang hanya pohon yang sudah cukup um: Cutting only trees that are old enough, not clear-cutting.
Jaga alam dengan reboisasi, tebang pilih: Protect nature with reforestation, selective logging, and the 3Rs.
Magnet: sifat, jenis, dan cara membuat: Magnets: properties, types, and how to make them
Menarik besi, baja, nikel, dan kobalt. M: They attract iron, steel, nickel, and cobalt. They have a north pole (N) and a south pole (S). Like poles repel, unlike poles attract.
Gaya tarik terkuat ada di kutub-kutubnya: The pulling force is strongest at the poles and weakest in the middle. Magnetic force can pass through thin objects like paper, cloth, and glass.
Magnet alam (batu magnetit) dan magnet b: Natural magnets (magnetite rock) and artificial magnets (bar, horseshoe, needle, cylinder, ring, disc). Permanent magnets last a long time (steel); temporary magnets lose their magnetism easily (soft iron).
Menggosok satu arah berulang-ulang, indu: Rubbing in one direction repeatedly, induction (placing it against a strong magnet), and electromagnetism (wrapping a current-carrying wire around a nail).
Bila magnet dipanaskan, dipukul, dijatuh: When a magnet is heated, hit, dropped repeatedly, or stored carelessly for a long time.
Kompas, pintu kulkas, speaker, bel listr: Compasses, fridge doors, speakers, electric bells, dynamos, maglev trains, and magnetic cranes at scrapyards.
Salah satu ujung magnet; menunjuk ke ara: One end of a magnet; it points north when hung freely.
Ujung lain magnet; menunjuk ke arah sela: The other end of a magnet; it points south when hung freely.
Bagian magnet dengan gaya tarik paling l: The part of the magnet with the weakest pulling force.
Dua kutub U–U atau S–S akan tolak-menola: Two N–N or S–S poles repel each other.
Kutub senama tolak-menolak, kutub tidak: Like poles repel, unlike poles attract.
Listrik: arus, pembangkit, dan rangkaian: Electricity: current, power plants, and circuits
Aliran muatan listrik (elektron) melalui: The flow of electric charge (electrons) through a conductor. It needs a voltage source, a conductor, a closed circuit, and a load.
Konduktor menghantarkan listrik dengan b: Conductors carry electricity well (copper, aluminium, iron, salt water). Insulators do not (plastic, rubber, glass, dry wood).
PLTA (air), PLTU (uap batu bara), PLTD (: Hydroelectric (water), steam (coal), diesel, geothermal (earth's heat), solar (sun), wind, and nuclear power plants.

Matikan lampu/TV/kipas saat tidak dipaka: Turn off lights/TV/fans when not in use, use LED lamps, unplug devices, and make use of sunlight.
Sumber tegangan yang mendorong arus list: The voltage source that pushes the electric current to flow.
Penghantar yang menghubungkan komponen r: The conductor that connects the parts of the circuit.
Menutup dan membuka rangkaian agar lampu: Closes and opens the circuit so the lamp turns on or off.
Beban yang menyala ketika arus listrik m: The load that lights up when electric current flows.
Rangkaian harus tertutup agar arus listr: The circuit must be closed for electric current to flow.

Lapisan batuan dan tanah yang menyusun k: The layers of rock and soil that make up the earth's crust.

Siklus air dan bumi yang bergerak: The water cycle and the moving earth
Evaporasi (penguapan), transpirasi (tumb: Evaporation, transpiration (plants releasing vapour), condensation (forming clouds), precipitation (rain), then infiltration and runoff back to the sea.
Bumi memiliki lempeng yang selalu berger: The earth has plates that are always moving slowly. Indonesia lies where the Indo-Australian, Eurasian, and Pacific plates meet, so it is prone to earthquakes and volcanoes.

Water vapour cools down and forms clouds.
